authorization.question: Do you authorize Kotallo to implement Codex, Oh My Pi, Pi, Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot and Cursor in parallel as their required loaders become ready, without another approval per adapter?
authorization.user_answer_verbatim: yes, fan out the work effectiely
authorization.effect: Standing authorization to implement all six harnesses; no additional approval per adapter. Supersedes earlier research-only/unanswered-release status.

fan_out_contract.mapper_ownership: Six independent harness mapper owners, each owning implementation, format fixtures, native-semantic expectations and adapter descriptor. Cursor transcript and IDE dialects must remain explicitly distinguished; split further only for genuine independent work.
fan_out_contract.shared_storage: One named integration owner for shared identity/checkpoint/envelope contracts; independently owned loader work for actual JSON snapshot/SQLite needs. VS Code mutation-journal reconstruction must use an explicit pure reducer/state contract, not treat each patch as a chat event.
fan_out_contract.parallelism: Ready JSONL mapper lanes need not wait for snapshot/SQLite implementation or a sibling mapper. Freeze the minimum input/output/metadata fixture contract, then map against fakes while loader work proceeds. Serialize only shared core/catalog/app mutations, not the independent implementations.
fan_out_contract.existing_substrate: Reuse the tested Plan005 loader/SessionAdapter/OTLP pipeline and Plan009's catalog contract as appropriate; do not rewrite or duplicate them. PM owns shared catalog/app registration and final composition. No silent edits to an already reviewed artifact.
fan_out_contract.models: Native OMP github-copilot/gpt-6-astra high for coders; independent OMP github-copilot/claude-opus-5 high review. Use current supported Builder/runtime behavior and explicit full clones where required; no invented legacy ack gates.
fan_out_contract.proof_ownership: Workers implement complete code, behavioral regressions and fixtures; PM owns coordinated formatting/build/lint/test runs and real composed SDK/CLI smoke. Avoid concurrent project-wide validators and shared lockfile edits.

requirements: Pure adapters have no filesystem, environment, network or clock access; storage I/O stays in loaders.
Common OTLP output and machine-readable adapter catalog expose honest capabilities and structured discovery hints.
Use observed native schemas and preserve source provenance; distinguish cumulative usage from per-update measurements and avoid double counting.
Treat delayed appends, mutable snapshots, revisions and source incompleteness explicitly; never use fake LF offsets for SQLite or claim EOF means final.

Report full-fidelity meaning, what is preserved/omitted, actual proof and remaining gaps for every adapter. Do not label a partial implementation complete or silently shrink named scope; unresolved formats need an explicit disposition.
Content remains explicit opt-in; use sanitized/synthetic fixtures and bounded structural evidence, not copied private payloads.
Harness-engineering is optional inspiration, not authority. Evaluate its code/fixtures and replace assumptions where Unisphere can do better.
Harness observations contain improvement-worthy friction, not progress reports. Progress goes in task/execution/status records.
boundaries: No additional user approval for each adapter's implementation.
Main landing, pushes/PRs, global changes, destructive retirement and private-data export remain outside this grant unless separately authorized.

Jordan controls compaction/restart. Known Kotallo custom-message delivery was unhealthy; queued transport alone does not prove receipt. Obtain actual acknowledgment, using prime's manual bridge if needed.
Retain ongoing Plan005/Plan009 evidence and work. Allocate follow-on product work through the current Builder mechanism; do not create duplicate PMs or duplicate worker assignments.
next_checkpoint: PM acknowledges this new grant, records plan/workspace and exact ownership/interfaces, and reports actual first parallel worker starts. Do not describe queued or failed spawns as running implementation.
